headline: A federal law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Ventura, California, after Captain Rosemary Bryant Mariner.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the Department of Veterans Affairs outpatient clinic in Ventura, California. The clinic will be called the Captain Rosemary Bryant Mariner Outpatient Clinic. It does not change the clinic's services, staff, or how veterans use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 11, 2022.
